# EchoScope – brand assets

## App icon (`echoscope_icon.svg`, generated by `build_icon.py`)

| Layer | Content |
|---|---|
| Canvas | Squircle, linear gradient charcoal-slate `#2A3B4F` → `#0B1118` (the app's dark canvas), medical-blue radial glow `#1E88E5` @ 38 % |
| Heart | Anatomical white heart `#F8FAFC`: ventricular body, aortic arch with three supra-aortic branches, pulmonary trunk, interventricular groove `#9FB3C8` |
| Transducer | Phased-array probe (body `#E2E8F0`, grip lines, cable `#64748B`, lens `#1E88E5`) aimed at the heart from the upper left, 45° |
| Acoustic sector | Beam wedge blue → emerald, four translucent wavefronts alternating `#42A5F5` / `#00897B` / `#1E88E5` crossing the heart |
| ECG | Lead II-style QRS complex in `#1DE9B6` with a dark keyline `#0B1118` and a soft glow, linking probe and heart |

Adaptive icon (Android 8+): `res/drawable/ic_launcher_background.xml` (gradient + glow),
`ic_launcher_foreground.xml` (all artwork inside the 66 dp safe circle) and
`ic_launcher_monochrome.xml` (Android 13 themed icons: heart, probe, two wavefronts).
All three are vectors, so no raster densities are needed. `echoscope_icon_512.png` is the
store / preview raster (render with Chromium from the SVG).

Rebuild after changing the geometry:

```
python3 brand_assets/build_icon.py
```

## Colour system

| Role | Brand hue | Dark theme text tone | Light theme text tone | Badge fill (white text) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medical blue (primary) | `#1E88E5` | `#42A5F5` (5.6 : 1) | `#1565C0` (5.1 : 1) | `#1565C0` (5.8 : 1) |
| Physiological emerald (normal) | `#00897B` | `#26A69A` (5.0 : 1) | `#00695C` (5.9 : 1) | `#00796B` (5.3 : 1) |
| Caution amber (borderline) | `#FB8C00` | `#FB8C00` (6.3 : 1) | `#9A4D00` (5.4 : 1) | `#B45309` (5.0 : 1) |
| Critical crimson | `#E53935` | `#FF6B66` (5.4 : 1) | `#C62828` (5.0 : 1) | `#C62828` (5.6 : 1) |

Contrast ratios are the minimum over background, card and raised card of each theme (WCAG
2.1 AA ≥ 4.5 : 1); `ThemeContrastTest` enforces them. The pure brand hues are kept for
graphics on dark imaging surfaces (cine loops, ECG, console, icon), where they are not text.

Canvas: dark `#0F1419` / cards `#171E26` / text `#F1F5F9`; light `#F8FAFC` / cards `#FFFFFF` /
text `#171E26`.
